description: An elderly tattooed man in a loincloth kneads green plant matter in a large wooden bowl of milky white liquid, while a boy pours more white liquid from a gourd. A tree trunk is tapped, with white sap running down a channel into a small pot. Behind them, a toddler reaches for black balls on a mat, and a seated man works with a dark cord. Thatched huts sit in dense jungle with shafts of light, and purple-stemmed plants lie on the ground. There is no visible text, frame or border.
